messages:
ana: FYI standup — what I did / blockers / today
ana: Did: validated canary run for 2026-03-17 train, merged perf tweaks for batching, queued cherry-pick for #4821 into stable.
ana: Blocker: cherry-pick hit a conflict on telemetry schema change, need a quick decision on keeping new schema or revert.
mike: saw the conflict — where is the PR? link?
ana: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/4821 — conflict in ./telemetry/events.proto
ana: Quick patch I tried: ```git fetch origin && git checkout -b cp-4821 origin/stable && git cherry-pick 7f3a2b4 && # conflict in events.proto``` results in proto version mismatch.
sophie: I can take the cherry-pick conflict, trying a merge strategy that keeps the new fields and not rename tags. ETA 30m. :hammer_and_wrench:
raj: Blocker for me: ML-inference CI flaked 3/4 nightly runs due to OOM on quant tests, looks like batch size estimator regressed after the perf tweak.
emily: Queued CI is long (~2h) because of the big release running parallel e2e. Can we gate some non-critical suites? We should avoid wasting limited GPU minutes.
mike: +1 on gating. Which suites are safe to skip? Suggest skip: integration/slow-rerank and the experimental iaas-sim tests for today.
emily: I'll mute those suites for the train and re-enable after canary. Doing it now.
release-bot: canary-deploy: started canary for train/2026-03-17 at 11:42 UTC on pool-gpu-a (10% traffic). Logs: https://deploys/internal/2026-03-17/ct-11:42
jordan: Question re: fallback — if canary fails, are we auto-falling back to model-variant v2-lite? Last time fallback didn't trigger for one host.
ana: Fallback policy is set to model-variant v2-lite + region fallback to us-west. I will verify the host-level health checks and increase probe sensitivity.
raj: If CI OOM persists, I recommend temporarily lowering max_batch_tokens to 512 on the canary config to avoid hitting the estimator.
sophie: Cherry-pick update: resolved proto conflict, kept new telemetry fields, added migration script. Pushed cp branch: git@repo:cp/4821-telemetry-fix. Running unit tests locally.
mike: Can someone approve #4821? it's blocking stable cut.
ana: @mike assigning you for quick review since you own telemetry. Also @sophie will post diff summary in the PR.
mike: On it, will review in 20m. :eyes:
emily: CI gating done. Removed experimental suites. Queue should clear ~40-50m.
ana: Plan for today: wait for PR approval + passing CI, monitor canary for 1hr after stable cut, if ML CI still flaking we'll roll a config change (raj's suggestion). If anything urgent ping #oncall.
ana: Final note: if anyone needs to cherry-pick additional fixes, please label them urgent/cherry and notify me directly. :thumbsup:
